title: SQL Server: HIERARCHYID arrives as the hex of its binary, not the path text

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: SQL Server 2022 CU27, standard and integrated CDC, one run

symptom: /1/2/ arrives as the string '5B40'; the root / arrives as an empty string. No warning.
cause: Not established: the value lands as the hex of the type's binary.
effect: Path comparisons on the destination don't match the source's path text.
fix: Not tested: keep a text copy of the path in another column on the source.
notes: One run per mode with the same result.
